violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: - OBSERVED: the sanitizing step of high-temperature dishwasher (bar) was not verified. Surface temperature of plate simulating dishwasher tester was 135f.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: main dishwasher and/or 3-compartment sink will be used to sanitize all food contact surfaces.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: - OBSERVED: high-temperature dishwasher (bar) is not sanitizing.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: please obtain urgent service for the unit within 10 calendar days.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the @LOCATION@ being used @OBSERVATION@. HAND SINK AT BACK PREP AREA WAS USED TO DUMP ICE.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS EDUCATED THE CFM.

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: AIR GAPS BETWEEN THE OUTLETS OF WASHING BASIN AND RINSING BASIN ARE NOT OBSERVED.
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch. CREATE AIR GAPS FOR WASHING BASIN AND RINSING BASIN SEPARATELY WITHIN 3 CALENDAR DAYS.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the 3-COMPARTMENT SINK are leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Fixed Equipment, Properly Spaced and Sealed
violations.observation: The following equipment is not installed in a manner that allows accessibility for cleaning, nor is it installed with closely abutting surfaces to minimize the need for cleaning: 3-compartment sink pulling away from wall.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment that is fixed because it is not easily movable shall be installed so that it is: 1) spaced to allow access for cleaning along the sides, behind, and above the equipment, 2) spaced from adjoining equipment, walls, and ceilings a distance of not more than 1 millimeter or one thirty-second inch, and 3) sealed to adjoining equipment or walls if the equipment is exposed to spillage or seepage.
